structures.preprocessing: Unscoped candidate rows. Approve the full-key population at cutover; use customer-cohort-project.json. Retain both external project/WBS identifiers and internal references. Rebuild hierarchy with target key maps; do not copy internal object numbers. Project costs are reference history. Status, networks, settlement rules, budgets, commitments and investment measures require a supported business interface and separate scope agreement. AUFK contains other order types too: select network types using verified order-type customizing, then close AFKO/AFVC/AFVV against the selected networks. Map internal routing, WBS and work-center IDs. Relationships, capacities, dates and status need the approved network business interface; this is no status replay.
